version.description: Config schema version for forward migration.

staleDays.description: Days without modification before an item is considered inactive.

categories.description: Map of category name -> absolute folder path.

tidyRules.description: Ordered tidy rules for loose top-level files.

keepers.description: Absolute paths or basenames that must never be moved/tidied.

budgetUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD for the budget window.

budgetTokens.description: Optional token cap (in + out) for the budget window.

budgetWindow.description: Window the budget caps apply to (default '7d' when caps are set).

tools.description: Map of integration name -> resolved executable path.

agentReportRollup.description: Optional count-only Phantom agent audit rollup for FleetStatus. Values and raw findings remain hidden.

enabled.description: When true, FleetStatus may include aggregate-only Phantom agent report counts.

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout for collecting the count-only rollup.

cacheTtlMs.description: Optional cache TTL for the count-only rollup.

locus.description: Optional Locus identity-plane settings for hub pre-mutate / CI session gates. DEFAULT ABSENT = off (monorepo-safe). Env LOCUS_ENFORCE wins over config when set. Set firm=true for production fleets (profile → enforce when enforce is unset); never default firm to true in monorepo.

enforce.description: off: no probe; warn: log blockers allow dispatch; enforce: fail closed. Unset and absent config both mean off. Explicit enforce beats firm profile.

firm.description: Firm profile for production fleets. When true and enforce is unset (and LOCUS_ENFORCE env is unset), resolveLocusEnforceMode returns enforce. Default false/absent — monorepo stays off. Env LOCUS_ENFORCE always wins (including LOCUS_ENFORCE=off). Set via: ashlr config set locus.firm true

maxRecall.description: Max number of recall hits returned/injected (default 5).

injectOnRun.description: Whether `ashlr run` injects top-k recall into sub-agent prompts (default true).

plugins.description: M33 plugin-system configuration. Default empty — enabled:[] means no plugins load.

enabled.description: Plugin names that are permitted to load.

foundry.description: v4/v5 autonomous-fleet configuration (M45+). Full key reference: docs/FOUNDRY-CONFIG.md. Declared exhaustively from AshlrConfig['foundry'] in src/core/types.ts (M340b). additionalProperties stays true: KNOWN_FOUNDRY_KEYS in src/core/effective-config.ts is the authoritative typo/unknown-key detector at config-load time (an accompanying human-readable warning, not a hard validation failure) and currently recognizes several keys this schema does not yet model 1:1 (e.g. acePlaybook, localization, redTeam, feedbackEnabled, stallIdleMs, strategistModel, managerJudgeModel, managerJudgeEngine, inventPerCycle, blastRadius) plus operator-extension keys consumed by tooling outside this package. This schema is documentation/editor metadata only; it is not loaded or enforced by any code path in src/.

executionIdentityV1.description: Default-off, shadow-only execution-account policy. Contains opaque references only; runtime paths and Phantom references live in the internal 0600 private store.

shadowOnly.description: V1 has no live-dispatch mode and accepts only true.

allowedBackends.description: Backends the fleet may use. Absent means ['builtin'] only.

autonomyControlLoop.description: M308: executable autonomy control loop gating daemon dispatch. Default true when foundry is present.

repairHandoffV2Write.description: Reader-first migration gate for objective-scoped repair handoff schema v2. Default false.

repairHandoffV2Activation.description: CLI-issued identity for the current v2 writer activation epoch.

id.description: Fresh UUID minted when the writer transitions disabled to enabled.

activatedAt.description: Canonical ISO timestamp recorded with the activation identity.

models.description: Per-backend preferred model id, keyed by EngineId.

claude5.description: M320: Claude 5 generation rollout (Sonnet 5 workhorse + Fable 5 judge/strategist). Absent means enabled.

fable.description: Use Fable 5 as default judge/strategist with fallback to opus-4-8. Default true.

modelGranularRouting.description: M323: model-granular cost-aware learned routing. DEFAULT OFF.

minShipRate.description: Minimum learned ship-rate for the cost-aware pick. Default 0.6.

bestOfN.description: M170/M333: best-of-N candidate generation count. Default 1 (single dispatch).

bestOfNCandidates.description: M333: per-candidate engine/model specs for multi-model best-of-N.

bestOfNMinItemScore.description: M333: fan out only for work items whose score >= this threshold.

outcomeWatcher.description: M332: observation-only revert/follow-up watcher. DEFAULT ON; false disables.

verifyToGreen.description: M331: verify-to-green bounded engine repair loop before filing a proposal. DEFAULT OFF.

perRunTimeoutMs.description: Per repair-run timeout in ms. Default 180000.

failureTailBytes.description: Verification-failure tail bytes fed back to the engine. Default 8192.

sandboxExternal.description: Run external engines inside a sandbox with diff capture. Default true when foundry is set.

timeoutMs.description: Hard wall-clock per external run (ms). Default 20 minutes.

completenessGate.description: M275: completeness + self-verify gate before filing a proposal. DEFAULT true.

mergeAuthority.description: Allowlist for the merge-authority gate: a proposal may auto-apply to main only if its {engine,model} matches an entry here.

limits.description: M46: per-backend rate limits for subscription backends, keyed by EngineId. Absent means unlimited.

engines.description: M50 (v5): declarative engine roster (EngineSpec per key). Overrides/extends BUILTIN_ENGINE_REGISTRY. Absent means exactly the builtin roster. See EngineSpec in src/core/types.ts.

nim.description: M195: NVIDIA NIM backend config (OpenAI-compatible cloud inference). Entirely opt-in.

apiKeyEnv.description: Env var NAME holding the bearer API key. Default 'NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY'.

kimi.description: Kimi/Moonshot resource hints (engine normally defined via foundry.engines.kimi).

tier.description: M270: promotes the kimi engine spec's tier (engine-registry.ts applyKimiConfig).

fleetMcp.description: M248: guarantee fleet sandboxed engines inherit ashlr-plugin MCP tools. DEFAULT true.

minItemValue.description: M124: backlog value filter floor. Default 2.

scanTodos.description: M136: TODO/FIXME marker scanner toggle. DEFAULT false.

scanDeps.description: M160: dependency-bump/npm-audit scanner toggle. DEFAULT false.

scanDependencyBumps.description: M271: mechanical npm-outdated package bump scanner toggle. DEFAULT false. Requires scanDeps=true.

scanLint.description: M160: lint-error scanner toggle. DEFAULT false.

scanHygiene.description: M160: repo-hygiene (README/LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING) scanner toggle. DEFAULT false.

goalPlanning.description: M222: goal to milestones auto-planning. DEFAULT true.

goalFocusMode.description: Defer new planning-goal expansion / generative invention while active goals have pending milestones. DEFAULT true.

goalFocusActiveThreshold.description: Active actionable-goal threshold for goalFocusMode. Default 4.

browserVerify.description: M167: headless browser verification of web-app renders after a diff. DEFAULT false (opt-in).

visualGrounding.description: Pluggable visual grounding layer for screenshot/document perception. DEFAULT false.

usePhantom.description: M168: opt-in phantom-secret injection for fleet verification/integration tasks. DEFAULT false.

diffSafety.description: M158: destructive-diff pre-judge guard. DEFAULT true.

tasteCritic.description: M183: frontier TASTE critic for best-of-N selection. DEFAULT false.

routingPolicy.description: M128: intelligent model-granular routing policy. Absent means 'balanced'.

learnedRouting.description: M240: bias engine/model selection using historical judge outcomes. DEFAULT true.

modelRacing.description: M166: model-racing + distillation dataset. DEFAULT DISABLED.

intelligence.description: M53: fleet-intelligence tuning (learned routing / budget recovery / anomaly holds). Absent means off.

pulseEmit.description: M214: emit GenAI-OTel spans to Pulse OTLP ingest. DEFAULT false.

skillLibrary.description: M243: skill-library write-back for realized merge proposals. DEFAULT true.

judgePerPass.description: M259: max frontier-judge calls per runAutoMergePass tick. Default 8.

autoArchiveAfterRejects.description: M259: auto-archive proposals after K consecutive non-ship verdicts. Default 3.

proposalTtlDays.description: M259: TTL for pending proposals in days. Default 7. Set 0 to disable.

simpleConductor.description: M280: use the flat-task dispatch loop instead of the goal-conductor. DEFAULT false.

resourceAwareDispatch.description: M300: check resource snapshot before dispatch and reroute to a fallback engine when exhausted. DEFAULT true.

dispatchRetries.description: M297: bounded retry count for transient external-agent aborts. Default 2.

killSwitch.description: Test/operator kill flag for sandboxed dispatch, more restrictive than the global ~/.ashlr/KILL switch only.

engineFallbackOrder.description: M300: fallback engine preference order when the primary engine is exhausted. Default ['codex','kimi','nim','local-coder'].

autoMerge.description: M47: tiered-trust auto-merge to main. DEFAULT DISABLED.

trustBasis.description: M153: authority model for Gate 4. Default 'tier'.

managerGate.description: Optional pass-level manager quality gate. Default false.

maxAutomergeFiles.description: Default 4, hard maximum 40 (MAX_AUTOMERGE_POLICY_FILES in src/core/foundry/automerge-scope-policy.ts — keep in sync).

maxAutomergeLines.description: Default 150, hard maximum 3000 (MAX_AUTOMERGE_POLICY_LINES in src/core/foundry/automerge-scope-policy.ts — keep in sync).

pushToRemote.description: Also merge/push on the remote (gh pr merge). Default false.

midToBranch.description: M56 (v5): permit mid-tier proposals to auto-apply to a branch/PR, never main. Default false.

allowWithoutVerification.description: Permit auto-merge when no verification commands are detected. Default false (fail-closed).

verifyBeforeJudgePerPass.description: Max verification-before-judge runs per auto-merge pass. Default judgePerPass.

generative.description: M181: generative engine ('rip mode') — invent bold net-new features. DEFAULT false (opt-in).

confinement.description: M52: per-engine OS-level confinement profiles, keyed by EngineId or '*' for a fleet-wide default. Absent means v4 env-only containment.

fabric.description: M247/SPEC-INFERENCE-FABRIC: InferenceGateway config. DEFAULT ABSENT means byte-identical to pre-M247.

gatewayShadow.description: M334: observe-only shadow mode beside legacy routing. Default false.

cacheShadow.description: M249: RunCache shadow measurement mode. Default false.

cache.description: M250: live cache short-circuit (not yet implemented). Default false.

resourceAware.description: M250: resource-aware backend demoting. Requires gateway=true. Default false.

concurrentDispatch.description: M255: dispatch across all backends with headroom in parallel. Requires gateway=true. Default false.

maxSlotsPerBackend.description: M255: max concurrent slots per backend. Default 3.

workhorseDispatch.description: M256: spread local-mid bulk items across workhorse backends. Requires concurrentDispatch=true. Default false.

productionVelocity.description: Production velocity profile. DEFAULT OFF. Boolean shorthand or an explicit resource-control profile object.

claudeResource.description: M250 Resource Control Plane: Claude subscription-window resource caps.

resourceOverrides.description: Operator resource overrides for known external capacity events (e.g. vendor weekly lockout), keyed by engine/backend id. Expired overrides are ignored automatically.

local.description: M250 Resource Control Plane: local/Ollama concurrency config.

edvVerify.description: M151: opt-in EDV (independent/external) verification signal folded into backlog item scoring. DEFAULT false.

ashlrcodeExecutor.description: M185: gate for the `ashlrcode` (ac) autonomous executor path. DEFAULT false.

specContract.description: Spec-contract acceptance-criteria checking gate. DEFAULT false (disabled).

repoMap.description: Inject a lightweight repo map into sandboxed-engine prompts. DEFAULT false.

proposalRepair.description: Repair-treatment maintenance pass toggle. DEFAULT true (opt-out via false). NOT YET present in KNOWN_FOUNDRY_KEYS (src/core/effective-config.ts) as of this pass.

daemon.description: Daemon loop tuning (M22+): budget caps, tick interval, parallelism, cooldowns.

agentOsObserver.description: Default-off observation-only Agent OS compiler. This block grants no execution or effect authority.

enabled.description: Exact opt-in. Absent or false schedules no observer child.

user.description: Fleet owner identity (M109) — attribution on pulse spans and team surfaces.

notify.description: Outward notification targets (M18) — opt-in webhook for run/swarm completion summaries.
